poc_summary: Purpose: validate Dedicated capacity for real-time recommendation service. Goals: demonstrate sustained throughput and tail latency under representative traffic. Targets: p50 <= 8ms (embedding lookups), p95 <= 60ms for 128-token generation paths, sustain 300 req/s mixed workload with 5% spike to 1k req/s for 5m without queue growth. Duration: 72-hour soak + isolated peak-hour stress. Tests: steady-state throughput, 5m spike tests, model-fallback failover (quantized vs fp16), end-to-end app integration with prefix KV cache warmup. Success criteria: no token-level errors, average unit cost within 20% of projected, documented repro steps for any SLO misses.
